Away Games
Upcoming away games are listed below. Please note that unless otherwise stated all away matches are sold on a one ticket per fan number basis. A queueing system is in operation before each on sale window
and sales will close 15-30 minutes before each on sale window.
You must bring photo ID (e.g. Passport, Driver's Licence) with you to the game. The ID must match the name of the owner of the ticket.
If the match you wish to attend is sold out please do not attempt to purchase from third-party resellers. If you have purchased tickets from anywhere other than this website, you may be a victim of ticket touting.
Click here for more information.

Free on a first come, first served basis.
You can only pick up a ticket for the fan event if you already have a match tickets for Nottingham Forest v Albion. If you are purchasing a match ticket now, you must wait 24 hours before picking up a ticket for the fan event.
